key: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king; for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do justice.
s: Closing the story of the two women and the sword, the verse turns to Israel; Radak, on 3:28, reads their fear as dread of doing wrong even in secret, since by his great wisdom he would bring judgement to light, as in this case.
